items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The proof is a two-input reduction: strict henselization changes neither the delta invariant (delivered delta-same-after-completion lemma) nor the number of geometric branches (immediate from its definition), after which the strictly henselian case is exactly the delivered sh companion. H2: the reduction mechanism is named and both inputs are delivered or definitional.
